title: The wipers
logline: The Legacy's windshield in October rain from the driver's seat, the wipers mid-stroke, 101 ahead, and on the dash the bird's absence: a clean rectangle in the dust where it stood a year ago. The page notices.

panels.composition: A station wagon's windshield from the driver's seat in rain with wipers mid-stroke and a coastal road ahead, a hand on the wheel, and on the dusty dashboard a clean rectangle where something stood.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, an old station wagon's windshield seen from the driver's seat in rain with wipers mid-stroke and a coastal road ahead, a hand on the wheel and a clean rectangle in the dashboard's dust where something once stood, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
